prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one actual medieval painted WOODEN SHOP SIGN for "Lothaires Arkaneum", square canvas, true transparent background. Complete EXACTLY CIRCULAR silhouette fully visible, approximately 85% canvas diameter with transparent margin on all sides. CLOSED elegant SILVER METAL FRAME with restrained fine geometric engraving. This is a tangible wooden disk of several joined planks, not a poster, portrait photograph, modern logo or three-dimensional sculpture.
On the planks is a FLAT HAND-PAINTED COMICAL CARICATURE of HERLUIN LOTHAIRE from reference 1, HEAD AND UPPER TORSO: an oversized eager grinning head, wildly spiked dark-gray hair becoming WHITE ONLY at the tips, tiny chin goatee WITHOUT mustache, one normal silver eye and one violet AMETHYST prosthetic eye with a few fine purple branching lines down the painted neck, simple dark scholar robe. He proudly cups ONE little PURPLE CRYSTAL SPHERE while his other painted hand flourishes above it. The sphere contains a soft purple swirl but no vision.
The caricature must look drawn by a medieval sign-painter using clear dark outlines and a few broad matte pigment shapes. Clearly visible WOOD GRAIN runs through the whole painted illustration; thin worn paint follows the planks. Simplify tiny details. Friendly absurd grandeur, recognizable as Herluin, no realistic face shading. Muted purples, ivory-gray hair and robe highlights, dark warm wood and a warm wooden/ochre face; silver is confined to the complete closed frame. NOT a glossy full-color illustrated poster pasted onto wood.
Along the lower painted band, modest hand-painted cream letters spell EXACTLY: LOTHAIRES ARKANEUM. Use ordinary Latin A letters, spelling "LOTHAIRES ARKANEUM", no other lettering.
Reference 1 defines ONLY Herluin's identity and expression. Reference 2 defines ONLY the crafted painted-wood sign and closed silver frame, never its chalice, grapes or colors.
Entire sign including outer rim fully opaque (Alpha255); all outside rim fully transparent Alpha0. No projecting corners, extra crest, chain, stand, hooks, wall, scenery, outer shadows, glow, or frame-breaking decoration. Frontal view, single isolated sign, PNG RGBA.
